observations.footwork: The fighter on the left moves in with a forward step, closing the distance to his partner.
observations.guard: Both fighters maintain a high guard with gloved hands positioned near the chin.
observations.upper_body: The fighter on the left extends his lead arm (jab) at F4, then extends the rear arm (cross) at F5. The partner raises his gloves to defend.
observations.distance: closes from medium to close range
observations.notable: Initial engagement initiated by the fighter on the left.

observations.footwork: The left fighter steps back, re-establishing a wider distance.
observations.guard: Both fighters return to a tight defensive guard.
observations.upper_body: The left fighter recovers to an upright posture.

observations.footwork: The left fighter steps in again, closing the distance.
observations.guard: The left fighter keeps his hands up while moving in.
observations.upper_body: The left fighter extends his lead arm (jab), then leans forward and down in a slipping or ducking motion at F10.
observations.notable: Second exchange; the left fighter evades after punching.

observations.footwork: The left fighter steps in for another exchange.
observations.guard: Both fighters maintain a high guard.
observations.upper_body: The left fighter extends his lead arm (jab) at F14 while the partner reacts defensively.

observations.footwork: The fighters separate by stepping back.
observations.guard: Both fighters have their guard up in a ready stance.
observations.upper_body: The left fighter is upright and in posture.
observations.notable: Reset or end of the sequence.

movement_events.detail: The fighter on the left extends his lead hand in a jab.
The fighter on the left extends his rear hand in a cross.
The left fighter steps back, creating space.
The left fighter steps in to close the distance.
The left fighter throws a jab.
The left fighter ducks or slips underneath.
The left fighter moves in again.
The left fighter extends his arm in a jab.
The fighters return to a neutral distance.
